select r.professor_id, r.name as professor_name, r.department, r.title, coalesce(p.paper_count, 0) as paper_count, coalesce(p.paper_score, 0) as paper_score, coalesce(prj.project_count, 0) as project_count, coalesce(prj.project_score, 0) as project_score, coalesce(pt.patent_count, 0) as patent_count, coalesce(pt.patent_score, 0) as patent_score, coalesce(b.book_count, 0) as book_count, coalesce(b.book_score, 0) as book_score, coalesce(a.award_count, 0) as award_count, coalesce(a.award_score, 0) as award_score, coalesce(p.paper_score, 0) + coalesce(prj.project_score, 0) + coalesce(pt.patent_score, 0) + coalesce(b.book_score, 0) + coalesce(a.award_score, 0) as total_score from ms_professor r left join ( select professor_id, count(*) as paper_count, coalesce(sum(actual_score), 0) as paper_score from ms_paper where status = '0' and year(publish_date) = #{_parameter} group by professor_id ) p on r.professor_id = p.professor_id left join ( select professor_id, count(*) as project_count, coalesce(sum(actual_score), 0) as project_score from ms_research_project where status = '0' and year(start_date) = #{_parameter} group by professor_id ) prj on r.professor_id = prj.professor_id left join ( select professor_id, count(*) as patent_count, coalesce(sum(actual_score), 0) as patent_score from ms_patent where status = '0' and year(grant_date) = #{_parameter} group by professor_id ) pt on r.professor_id = pt.professor_id left join ( select professor_id, count(*) as book_count, coalesce(sum(actual_score), 0) as book_score from ms_book where status = '0' and year(publish_date) = #{_parameter} group by professor_id ) b on r.professor_id = b.professor_id left join ( select professor_id, count(*) as award_count, coalesce(sum(actual_score), 0) as award_score from ms_award where status = '0' and year(award_date) = #{_parameter} group by professor_id ) a on r.professor_id = a.professor_id where r.status = '0' order by total_score desc
